title: Proposed production verification negative-case inventory
scope: Abstract behavior invariants for B1 discussion. These cases define no endpoints, method signatures, wire error codes, or accepted backend schema.

preconditions: Caller has no valid authenticated identity context.
cases.action: Attempt a protected verification read and a protected state-changing operation through the eventual authoritative backend boundary.
expected_invariants: Neither operation exposes protected verification data nor changes authoritative state.
The backend response is handled according to a separately agreed error contract.

preconditions: Caller is authenticated as identity A.
cases.action: Attempt an operation whose claimed actor or target identity is identity B without authority to act for B.
expected_invariants: Actor identity is derived from or cryptographically bound to authenticated authority.
No state belonging to B is disclosed or changed.

preconditions: A request is pending for recipient A.
cases.action: Identity B attempts to decide the request.
expected_invariants: Only the authorized recipient can decide the pending request.
The request and approval state remain unchanged after the unauthorized attempt.

preconditions: An identity is eligible to receive approvals.
cases.action: The identity attempts to approve itself through any approval pathway.
expected_invariants: An identity cannot contribute its own approval.
No approval count or access status changes from the self-approval attempt.

preconditions: An active verification session belongs to candidate A and has an authorized participant B.
cases.action: A different actor or a participant from another session submits a decision against that session.
expected_invariants: The decision is bound to the authenticated actor and the intended session.
No unrelated candidate/session state is changed.

preconditions: A verification session has expired or reached a terminal state.
cases.action: Submit an approval or session mutation using the expired session context.
expected_invariants: Expired or terminal session state cannot accept new approvals.
No approval or access status changes from the stale action.

preconditions: An invitation draft is created with an explicit approval opt-in value.
cases.action: Alter the submitted invitation draft's `vouch` / approval-for-invitee intent after creation or during redemption.
expected_invariants: Invitation alone adds no approval unless the separately authorized and recorded approval intent is valid.
Client-altered approval intent cannot create an approval without authoritative inviter eligibility and recipient/identity binding.

preconditions: A request has already received a terminal decision.
cases.action: Replay the same decision or submit a conflicting second decision.
expected_invariants: A terminal request cannot produce duplicate approvals or be silently changed to a conflicting outcome.
Any idempotency or conflict response follows an agreed contract.

preconditions: An approver was eligible when a request or session was created, then loses eligibility before approval is accepted.
cases.action: Submit an approval using the stale eligibility state.
expected_invariants: Eligibility is checked at the authoritative acceptance point.
An ineligible approver does not add an approval.

preconditions: Candidate has exactly three distinct accepted approvals and two distinct eligible approvers can submit concurrently.
cases.action: Accept both eligible approvals concurrently as the candidate reaches the four-approval threshold.
expected_invariants: Both distinct valid approvals are retained; concurrent acceptance loses neither approval.
The transition to verified occurs exactly once.
Exactly one durable completion event is recorded for that verified transition.

preconditions: Browser-local verification or vouch data can be edited by the caller.
cases.action: Alter local approval/status data, then request a protected operation.
expected_invariants: Browser-local state alone cannot grant authoritative verification status or protected access.
The authoritative decision uses server-validated state.

preconditions: Two distinct authenticated identities have separate verification state.
cases.action: Identity A requests or replays a read for identity B's private request, invitation, session, or history data without authorization.
expected_invariants: Private data is scoped to authorized principals.
No cross-identity data is disclosed or mutated.

preconditions: An operation requires a signature under the eventual agreed authority model.
cases.action: Submit a missing, invalid, altered, or identity-mismatched signature/proof.
expected_invariants: The operation is rejected by the authoritative boundary.
No approval, identity binding, or access state is created from invalid proof.

preconditions: An identity has an authoritative verification status determined by accepted approvals.
cases.action: Attempt to overwrite verification/access status directly, bypassing the authoritative approval transition.
expected_invariants: Status changes only through the authoritative approval transition and its validated prerequisites.
A direct overwrite or bypass attempt is rejected and leaves the authoritative status unchanged.
